sloka: तं राम: पुरुषव्याघ्रो लक्ष्मणं प्रत्युवाच ह ।अङ्गावेक्षस्व सौमित्रे कस्येमां मन्यसे चमूम् ॥ २.९६.१५॥
transliteration: taṁ rāma: puruṣavyāghro lakṣmaṇaṁ pratyuvāca ha ।aṅgāvekṣasva saumitre kasyemāṁ manyase camūm ॥ 2.96.15॥

translations.english: Rama the best among men replied to Lakshamana, Oh, Lakshmana, look properly and tell me to whom do you think this army might belong
